agent_card.name: MCP-Forge Validator
agent_card.description: Validates generated MCP tool code: static checks, then a behavioural check that calls every tool through an MCP server against mocked HTTP.

skills.name: Validate MCP tools
skills.description: Send Python tool functions as a text part and the endpoints they must implement as a data part ({"endpoints": [...]}). Returns a pass/fail verdict with one structured error per problem.

security_agent_card.name: MCP-Forge Security Reviewer
security_agent_card.description: Reviews generated MCP tool code without running it: each tool may make only its own documented request and use only allowlisted names. Flags instruction-like text in tool descriptions (tool poisoning).

skills.name: Security review of MCP tools
skills.description: Send the generated tool functions (without the server header) as a text part and the endpoints as a data part ({"endpoints": [{"name", "method", "path", ...}]}). The code is never executed. Returns a pass/fail verdict with one structured error per problem, plus warnings that do not block.
